resources.string: No game is set up. Choose the folder of your extracted disc (default.xbe and its files), or a disc image (.iso).
No game data found in %1$s (no default.xbe there). Choose the game folder or a disc image.
The game folder %1$s is no longer there (deleted, or its SD card removed). Choose the game again.
The game folder %1$s cannot be read: All files access is off. Turn it on again (choose the folder again to be asked), or choose the game again.
The game is running: it closes when you choose another one. Saves are kept.
This folder holds no default.xbe: it is not an extracted Xbox disc. Choose the folder that contains default.xbe.
%1$s is not a disc image: choose a file ending in .iso or .xiso.
Not an Xbox disc image, or no default.xbe in it: %1$s
This is not the game this app was made for (another game, or another region): its default.xbe does not match. Nothing was changed.
Not enough free space: the game needs %1$s, %2$s are free.
The import failed: %1$s. Nothing was changed.
This device has no file picker.

With « All files access », the app reads the game straight from the folder you choose, on the phone or on an SD card: no copy, and it works for a 4 GB disc. The app only reads the game folder you pick.\n\nWithout it, the folder is copied into the app\'s own storage: that takes as much free space again and a few minutes, and the copy is removed with the app.
